details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K4, K7, and K8 are fully represented with supporting sentences. K3 is PARTIALLY_PRESENT because only INFLECION Phase 1 completion is mentioned; the SEK 350M co-funded program and SEK 11.8M EPS-Sterna order details are missing. K5 (Bonnier Capital investment) and K6 (market positioning strategy) are entirely absent. The overall coverage is strong but missing two HIGH-importance items and one partially covered item, placing it in the 'Generally yes' category.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. It presents a clear narrative of declining financial performance in 2025 due to programme delays, with consistent explanations across all sections. The summary logically connects revenue declines (S1-S2), EBITDA compression (S3), operating losses (S4), and cash flow deterioration (S11-S12). Segment analysis (S6, S9) shows contrasting performance between Products & Missions and Data & Services, which aligns with the stated primary cause of programme delays (S7-S8). The summary concludes with post-year-end improvements (S13-S17) that logically contrast the annual results, showing a coherent before/after narrative. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetition. All figures and relationships are presented without implying arithmetic contradictions.
